# Praetor Source-Bound Machine Reference

> Compatibility endpoint: current policy values stay in their authoritative repository sources and are not copied here. Checked-in desired state does not certify live hosted state.

Use `/llms.txt` for the concise public documentation index. This compatibility
surface names the repository files that own current behavior so policy, required
checks, and review settings cannot drift here as copied prose.

## Canonical repository authorities

- **Effective governance manifest** — source: `.standards.yaml`. Repository identity, enabled facets, policy inputs, and local governance configuration.
- **Checked-in branch ruleset** — source: `.github/rulesets/main.json`. Declarative desired branch rules and required status contexts; query the forge for live enforcement.
- **Go toolchain directive** — source: `go.mod`. Go language version authority for the module and its build.
- **Documentation workflow** — source: `.github/workflows/praetor-docs.yml`. Hosted job that runs the documentation gate under the required status context.
- **Canonical agent harness** — source: `AGENTS.md`. Agent operating rules and text-register routing compiled into vendor projections.
- **HISS specification** — source: `docs/standards/hiss-spec.md`. Reviewed invariant definitions and enforcement expectations.
- **Operational sync contract** — source: `docs/guides/operational-sync.md`. Boundary between checked-in desired state and live forge reconciliation.
- **Documentation governance contract** — source: `docs/guides/documentation-governance.md`. Machine-documentation catalog ownership, deterministic parity, source binding, and local verification commands.

## Public documentation map

### Core Governance & Invariants

- [HISS Formal Specification](https://cordanallm.github.io/praetor/standards/hiss-spec/) — source: `docs/standards/hiss-spec.md`. Complete specification of HISS-01 through HISS-21 invariants.
- [Model Routing & Capacity Arbiter](https://cordanallm.github.io/praetor/standards/model-routing-and-fanout/) — source: `docs/standards/model-routing-and-fanout.md`. Orchestration and fallback cascade for frontier and open models.
- [Agent Hooks & Operating Harness](https://cordanallm.github.io/praetor/guides/agent-hooks/) — source: `docs/guides/agent-hooks.md`. Canonical operating instructions and native client hook coverage.
- [Archetype Authoring](https://cordanallm.github.io/praetor/guides/archetype-authoring/) — source: `docs/guides/archetype-authoring.md`. Archetype authoring, lattice joins, and profile manifests.
- [Developer Onboarding](https://cordanallm.github.io/praetor/guides/onboarding/) — source: `docs/guides/onboarding.md`. Developer setup, Git hooks, and environment bootstrapping.
- [Architectural Decision Records](https://cordanallm.github.io/praetor/adr/) — source: `docs/adr/README.md`. ADR directory and architectural decision history.

### CLI Reference & Tooling

- [Fast Repository Adoption](https://cordanallm.github.io/praetor/adoption/) — source: `docs/adoption.md`. One-step repository onboarding through the CLI, MCP, and hosted automation.
- [Universal Dogfooding & Public Benchmarks](https://cordanallm.github.io/praetor/dogfooding/) — source: `docs/dogfooding.md`. Self-governance auditing and dry-run benchmarking against non-owned public repositories.
- [API Reference](https://cordanallm.github.io/praetor/wiki/API-Reference/) — source: `docs/wiki/API-Reference.md`. Existing command and service reference for praetorctl and standardsctl.
- [Operational Sync & Branch Protection](https://cordanallm.github.io/praetor/guides/operational-sync/) — source: `docs/guides/operational-sync.md`. Declarative reconciliation of hosted rules, labels, and branch protection.

### Community & Funding

- [Polar.sh Issue Bounties](https://cordanallm.github.io/praetor/sponsoring/) — source: `docs/sponsoring.md`. Feature bounties and contributor rewards split via Polar.sh MoR.
- [Monetization Strategy](https://cordanallm.github.io/praetor/monetization/) — source: `docs/monetization.md`. In-IDE passive monetization (Idlen) and enterprise licensing framework.
